messages:
Aisha (growth): idea: run a 10-day micro-launch called 'Prompt Sprint' tied to a single short webinar + two office hours. goal = drive first-5-requests and capture 3 short benchmark stories for a launch post.

Marco (content): recommend focusing on 'onboarding emails' as the vertical. easy to benchmark and share screenshots. i'll prepare 3 prompt templates and a short demo script.

Leah (events): tentative dates: webinar 2024-11-20, office hours 11-22 and 11-25. i'll handle registration cadence (confirm, 24h, 1h, and post-event).

Aisha (growth): credits model: 10 credits for registrants, 60 credits for attendees who submit the benchmark (3 outputs). leaderboard for top 5 gets extra $100 credit and a shoutout.

Drew (analytics): metrics: reg -> attended -> submission -> first_5_requests -> d7_retention. i'll create a dashboard tile and provide SQL segments. include grant_reason in event payload.

Marco (content): messaging tests: Subject A: 'Redeem your Prompt Sprint credits' vs B: 'Ship 3 onboarding emails in 30 minutes'. also 2 CTA variants.

Leah (events): ops question: can we auto-grant only after submission event to avoid errors? ops-bot?

ops-bot: scheduled reminder 2024-11-10 09:00 to set up grant webhook that checks event:benchmark_submitted before issuing credits.

Aisha (growth): next steps: Marco to drop prompts & copy by 2024-11-05; Leah to book webinar by 2024-11-03; Drew to wire dashboard by 2024-11-07. i'll coordinate post-event nurture.

Marco (content): will post drafts in #marketing-drafts and tag this thread when ready.

Drew (analytics): noted, will share sample event schema soon.

Aisha (growth): short and sweet: narrow vertical, gated credits, leaderboard incentive, and a 24h activation nudge. small test, quick learn. :rocket:
